composition.sheet_layout: Orthographic turnaround across the top with expression studies and proportion guide below.
composition.proportion_guide: Keep head-to-body ratio, shoulder width, coat hem, and ticket-punch hand scale consistent.

manga_style.linework: clean ink linework with restrained screen tones
manga_style.line_weight_strategy: Strong outer silhouette, medium garment construction, and fine facial details.

manga_style.screen_tones: Light neutral tones distinguish coat layers without introducing color.
manga_style.contrast_plan: Face, hands, and silhouette remain legible at reduced reference size.
manga_style.depth_plan: Flat reference presentation with only enough form shading to explain construction.
manga_style.motion_language: Static turnaround poses; expression studies may use subtle head angles only.
